prompt: it takes 3 men 8 hours to build a wall. How long would it take 4 men to build the same wall?
response: If 3 men take 8 hours to build the wall, 4 men would take less time because there are more workers. To find the time, you can set up a proportion: if 3 men take 8 hours, then 4 men would take \( \frac{3 \times 8}{4} = 6 \) hours. So, it would take 4 men 6 hours to build the same wall.
